additional_info.subject: RE: ID0454435-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370049] Log Control issues CRM:03056000126
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Bartolomeo,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0454435.
The ticket was opened for a logs analysis request on charger Y2 / S1 313508370049 on 07.10.2025.
I analyzed the logs, and these is the outcome:
At 2025-10-07T16:19:27, a RemoteStartTransaction is done via APP for outlet DC1, but subsequently DC2 is connected. Session of course fails.
At 2025-10-07T16:21:29, a RemoteStartTransaction is done via APP for outlet DC2, but subsequently DC1 is connected. Session of course fails.
At 2025-10-07T16:29:47, a RemoteStartTransaction is done via APP for outlet DC1, but subsequently DC2 is connected. Session of course fails.
I checked the outlet configuration on SCB, and everything looks normal:
Also on the HMI, there should be no confusion on the outlet ID:
In conclusion, the sessions failed due to a misbehavior of the end customer while charging, or there might be an issue with the outlet IDs on the 3rd party app.
If there are no further questions, since no issue on the charger has been identified, and no further points are pending on service side, I would proceed to close the ticket.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
